inactive_message.description: Shown on the hosted page when the link is inactive (Stripe parity).

line_items.description: 1..20 items with inline price_data, all in the same currency, collapsed onto the flat total (spec 22745 P4). No price lookup ids; adjustable_quantity is rejected until the hosted page grows a quantity selector. Mutually exclusive with the flat amount/currency shape. Itemization is served by GET /v1/payment_links/{link}/line_items.

payment_method_types.description: HONORED (spec 22745 P4, owner decision 2026-07-13): validated against the launch vocabulary, persisted, rendered, and forwarded to the hosted Checkout Session. Entries outside the vocabulary are a Stripe-shaped 400.

restrictions.description: Stripe reuse limit (spec 22745 P1). completed_sessions.limit caps how many completed sales the link accepts; the link auto-deactivates at the limit.

PaymentLinkMetadata.description: Payment Link merchant metadata. At most 50 entries; keys are at most 40 characters and values at most 500 characters. The case-insensitive fluveo_ namespace and payment_link key are server-reserved and rejected. Update merges entries; an empty value deletes that key.

PaymentLinkUpdate.description: Updatable: active, expires_at, metadata, after_completion, restrictions, inactive_message, submit_type — aligned with the service's SUPPORTED_UPDATE (spec 22745 P0). Sent as application/x-www-form-urlencoded.

active.description: false deactivates immediately and short-circuits other fields. true is a no-op while already payable; an unpaid, unexpired manually inactive link may reactivate. Completed or expired links return 400 without mutation.

after_completion.description: Discriminated completion behavior: redirect requires redirect.url; hosted_confirmation requires hosted_confirmation.custom_message (spec 22745 P3).

expires_at.description: Unix timestamp; Fluveo extension. When supplied, must be 30 minutes to 30 days from request time. Omission leaves the stored expiry unchanged; an already-expired link cannot extend its deadline.

inactive_message.description: Shown on the hosted page when the link is inactive (Stripe parity).

restrictions.description: Stripe reuse limit (spec 22745 P1). completed_sessions.limit caps how many completed sales the link accepts; the link auto-deactivates at the limit.

info.description: Curated launch subset of Stripe API v2026-05-27.dahlia that Fluveo /v1 promises shape-compatibility for. This is not the full Stripe API; every included operation uses Stripe path names, field names, auth schemes, form-encoded POST bodies, and list envelopes.
info.title: Stripe-compat subset — Fluveo launch contract

get.description: Retrieve the merchant Checkout Branding default used by hosted Checkout Sessions. This is the Stripe-shaped merchant-facing branding object described by ADR 0020.

put.description: Replace or upsert the merchant Checkout Branding default. URL assets are accepted; file-backed assets return a Stripe-shaped 400 until Files API support ships.

post.description: Create a checkout session backed by a real PaymentIntent. application/x-www-form-urlencoded with Stripe bracket nesting is the documented contract (ADR 0004). Idempotency-Key uses the durable 24-hour merchant/mode journal: an identical replay returns the original status and JSON bytes with Idempotent-Replayed: true; reuse with different parameters or another operation is a 400 idempotency_error.

Update a session. Only metadata, customer_email, and shipping_details are updatable at launch; metadata keys with the reserved fluveo_ prefix are rejected with a 400 naming the key. Idempotency-Key durably binds the merchant, mode, operation, session id, and typed request for 24-hour byte-identical replay.

Expire an open session (cancels the backing PaymentIntent). Sessions that are already complete or expired return a 400. Idempotency-Key durably binds the merchant, mode, operation, and session id for 24-hour byte-identical replay.

get.description: Mint (or return) the opaque signed hosted invoice page address for a finalized invoice. A paid invoice's link is revoked (404).

List payment links in created-desc order. status=active selects the effective payable state: active=true, future expires_at, and no exhausted completion limit. inactive, expired, and complete are compatible-subset aliases for the non-payable side rather than distinct lifecycle states. Cursor pagination (starting_after/ending_before) takes a plink_ id checked before lookup; a malformed cursor is a 400 invalid_request naming the param, and an absent, foreign-merchant, or wrong-mode cursor is the same 404 resource_missing. This surface is merchant- and mode-scoped through the Fluveo /v1 tenant wrapper.

parameters.description: Payment Link effective-state filter. active selects links that are enabled, unexpired, and below any completion limit; inactive, expired, and complete alias the non-payable side.
parameters.name: status

post.description: Create a reusable merchant-owned payment link from exactly one money shape: flat amount/currency or inline line_items. The body is application/x-www-form-urlencoded (ADR 0004). Idempotency-Key replay returns the original link; reuse with different parameters is a 409 idempotency_error. expires_at is a Fluveo extension and defaults to 24 hours.

get.description: Retrieve a payment link by its plink_ id. The Fluveo /v1 tenant wrapper scopes the read to the active merchant; foreign or tampered ids return resource_missing.

post.description: Update active, expires_at, metadata, after_completion, restrictions, inactive_message, or submit_type. amount/currency remain immutable. Metadata merges atomically and empty values delete keys. The Fluveo /v1 tenant wrapper scopes the mutation to the active merchant and mode.
Expire a payment link so it accepts no further payments. The Fluveo /v1 tenant wrapper scopes the mutation to the active merchant.
